description_en: Queries the download and parsing progress of data tracking logs
description_zh: 查询下载数据追踪日志解析结果进度
name: QueryDataTrackResultDownloadStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to query the ID of the ticket
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the download key, which is used to identify the parsing progress of data tracking logs. You can call the DownloadDataTrackResult operation to query the ID of the key
parameters.help_zh:
下载key，定位数据追踪日志解析结果进度。可通过
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261365.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: download_key_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the ID of the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

StatusResult.description_en: The information about the download progress

DownloadStatus.description_en:
The status of the download task. Valid values:

INIT: The download task is being initialized.
LISTING: The download task is in a transient intermediate state during the initialization.
DOWNLOADING: The download task is being processed.
DOWNLOAD_SUCCESS: The download task was successfully processed.
DOWNLOAD_FAIL: The download task failed
DownloadStatus.description_zh:
下载任务状态，取值和说明如下：
INIT：任务初始化。
LISTING：任务初始化中，短暂中间态。
DOWNLOADING：下载中。
DOWNLOAD_SUCCESS：下载成功。
DOWNLOAD_FAIL：下载失败

DownloadUrl.description_en: The URL that is used to download data tracking logs. This parameter is returned only when the value of DownloadStatus is DOWNLOAD_SUCCESS
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 下载链接。仅当下载任务状态为DOWNLOAD_SUCCESS时返回

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
